Market intelligence reports indicate that the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max have sold well in China, making Apple the best-selling smartphone brand in the country during their launch week.

Counterpoint Research says there are three main reasons why Apple's latest iPhones have proven so popular…

Counterpoint Research's "China Weekly Smartphone Retail Tracker" noted that since July this year, overall sales of new phones in China had fallen 17% year on year due to rising costs. However, the firm said this downward trend reversed with the launch of the iPhone 18 Pro.

Three reasons for success

Counterpoint believes three factors lie behind the strong popularity of the new models.

First, the standard iPhone 18 has been delayed on sale. Because Apple launched the two iPhone 18 Pro models ahead of the standard version, some consumers may have opted to upgrade straight to the higher-end version rather than keep waiting.

Second, price hikes across high-end smartphones have made consumers more willing than before to absorb higher price tags. Apple has absorbed part of the increased component costs, making the iPhone 18 Pro relatively strong in price-to-performance ratio.

Third, Counterpoint describes it as "aggressive channel support", which generally refers to large-scale marketing and promotional activities by retailers and carriers.
